items.label: 14 Oct 2004
items.title: The ares line begins
items.detail_md: bsnes starts, later leading to higan and ares.

items.label: 25 Jul 2026
items.title: Phobos forks ares
items.detail_md: To bring it to Android.

items.label: 27 Jul 2026
items.title: Phobos runs on Android
items.detail_md: The 64-bit native app, with native Vulkan for the N64.

items.label: 20 Aug 2026
items.title: v1.0.0
items.detail_md: Neo Geo, the GPU Driver Manager, PC Engine and SuperGrafx.

items.label: 15 Sep
items.title: Ground rules
items.detail_md: Speed claims need measurements, and changes need independent review.

items.label: 24 Sep
items.title: First pull request merged
items.detail_md: A fix for Neo Geo CD's garbled menu text (#1).

items.label: 25-28 Sep
items.title: The N64 speed push
items.detail_md: Linked JIT blocks (#10), NEON in the RSP (#15, #16), more RDP contexts (#17) and less power (#18).

items.label: 27-28 Sep
items.title: The app gets its look
items.detail_md: 37 themes (#9), the performance overlay (#5) and a glass look (#20).

items.label: 28 Sep
items.title: v1.1.0
items.detail_md: Pull requests #1 to #25, frontends that start games included.

items.label: 28 Sep
items.title: In-app updates
items.detail_md: Phobos updates itself from GitHub releases (#26).

items.label: 29 Sep
items.title: A PSP core goes on the plan
items.detail_md: Aiming to rival PPSSPP in compatibility and speed.

items.label: 30 Sep
items.title: Controllers drive the menus
items.detail_md: The D-pad, stick and shoulder buttons drive the menus (#51).

items.label: 3 Oct
items.title: Back on the desktop
items.detail_md: Desktop builds (#97), and Phobos's own code goes GPL-3.0-or-later (#98).

items.label: 3 Oct
items.title: The PSP core's first code
items.detail_md: The CPU core and a first measurement on a real PSP.

items.label: 5 Oct
items.title: The PSP in the app at 60 fps
items.detail_md: PSP SDK samples run on my RP6, and on the host Lumines and Street Fighter III 3rd Strike reach their title screens.

items.label: 6 Oct
items.title: Full speed, and all 266 games run
items.detail_md: Peace Walker, Liberty City Stories and Lumines at full speed on my RP6, plus the runner's first pass over all 266 (#154).

items.label: 7 Oct
items.title: The PSP on the GPU
items.detail_md: A hardware renderer on Vulkan.

items.label: 11 Oct
items.title: v2.0.0, the first with the PSP
items.detail_md: The PSP core, Experimental, as one stack of about 100 pull requests (#208).

items.label: 12 Oct
items.title: v2.1.0
items.detail_md: Fixes from playing v2.0.0 on my RP6, and the PSP's system dialogs (#221).

items.label: 13 Oct
items.title: v2.2.0
items.detail_md: First speedups for the slow games, and fewer Vulkan stalls.

items.label: 14 Oct
items.title: v2.3.0
items.detail_md: Savedata, system fonts, God Eater 2 and CI lanes for the test plan.

items.label: 14 Oct
items.title: Measured on the RP6 before merging
items.detail_md: The headless runner comes to Android (#255).

items.label: 15-16 Oct
items.title: The whole library at 5x on the RP6
items.detail_md: No crashes in 266 games, and 232 averaged 59 fps or more.

items.label: 16 Oct
items.title: v2.4.0
items.detail_md: Polling loops skipped where exact, Vulkan depth and stencil, and EDATA and PGD files.

items.label: 16 Oct
items.title: Timing games on a real PSP
items.detail_md: Real games take 4 to 12 times what the old model charged.

items.label: 18 Oct
items.title: The GE gets a separate thread
items.detail_md: Exact, and off by default (#272), plus screenshots that hop into a folder (#273).

items.label: 19 Oct
items.title: Real PSP timing becomes the default
items.detail_md: The GE takes about as long as my PSP-1000 did (#269).

items.label: 20 Oct
items.title: The GE thread shows the frame
items.detail_md: #277 lands, and #290 fixes the N64 recompiler on x86-64.

items.label: 21 Oct
items.title: N64 on the stock Qualcomm driver
items.detail_md: No more black screen on the RP6's stock driver (#292), and Super Monkey Ball gets within 15% of the PSP (#291).
